# Importer contract catalog

<!-- This file is generated by tools/generate_importer_contracts.py. -->

Every importer has a versioned `importer.contract.json` at its service root.
Those files are the repository source of truth for the supported input shapes,
service boundary, normalized output metrics and execution capabilities. CI validates
the contracts and this page is generated from them; edit the contract files rather
than this page.

OpenAPI is used as an upstream reference where a provider exposes it. It is not
forced onto file exports: iCalendar follows RFC 5545, Apple Health exports XML
archives, and WHOOP exports ZIP archives of CSV files. The contract format keeps
all of these input types explicit without pretending they share an API schema.

## Common guarantees

All eight importers publish tenant-scoped events to NATS JetStream, do not access
a database, fetch connector configuration through Core, propagate `X-Request-ID`,
resolve metric names through the shared registry, and include an idempotency key.
The metric list below is the set registered for that source; dynamic namespaces
are shown separately where the user's installation determines the fields.

## `apple_health`

- Ingest subject: `qs.ingest.apple_health`
- Task subject: `not applicable (push/file source)`
- Entrypoint: `apple_health_importer.main`
- Capabilities: scheduled sync `false`, webhook `true`, file upload `true`
- Input contracts:
  - `Health Auto Export webhook JSON` (`json`; [source](https://help.healthyapps.dev/en/health-auto-export/export-format/workouts))
  - `Apple Health export archive` (`zip_xml_gpx`; [source](https://support.apple.com/guide/iphone/share-your-health-data-iph5ede58c3d/ios))
- Registered metrics: `blood_oxygen`, `blood_pressure_diastolic`, `blood_pressure_systolic`, `body_fat`, `body_weight`, `distance`, `energy_active`, `energy_resting`, `exercise_duration`, `heart_rate`, `heart_rate_resting`, `heart_rate_walking_average`, `hrv_sdnn`, `location_point`, `nutrition_energy`, `respiratory_rate`, `sleep_duration`, `sleep_duration_awake`, `sleep_duration_deep`, `sleep_duration_in_bed`, `sleep_duration_light`, `sleep_duration_rem`, `stand_duration`, `steps`, `vo2_max`, `workout_cadence`, `workout_cycling_cadence`, `workout_cycling_power`, `workout_distance`, `workout_duration`, `workout_elevation_gain`, `workout_elevation_loss`, `workout_energy`, `workout_heart_rate_average`, `workout_heart_rate_max`, `workout_intensity`, `workout_lap_length`, `workout_speed_average`, `workout_speed_max`, `workout_steps`, `workout_swim_cadence`, `workout_swimming_strokes`
- Dynamic namespaces: `apple_health_`

The complete machine-readable contract is next to the importer service.
